name: M5.Lift.cyclic_as_sub
statement: ∀ N : ℕ, M5.cyclicModulus N = (Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ N - 1
guidance: Characteristic two makes minus one equal plus one. Unfold M5.cyclicModulus; use characteristic-two lemmas or prove (1 : ZMod 2) = -1 and lift it to polynomials. Return tactic lines without a leading by. This is a conditional lemma in section 5, not the full M5 theorem. Mathlib.Algebra.CharP.Two is imported; CharTwo.neg_eq is available.
